business: Frozen integrity verifies manifest structure, exact required member bytes, identities and declared cross-bindings. It does not authenticate publisher standing, present permission or semantic admission.
bridge: AlchLang owns manifest/schema selection, closure/privacy/binding gates, link namespaces, Pack identity and output claim ceilings. The generic artifact adapter only reads the source-selected frozen structure and invokes those exact compiled gates.
system: A bounded frozen-artifact reader composes the native graph continuation, byte references and native JSON plans. Reconstruction publishes the exact verified byte-reference set plus original manifest, atomically without overwrite.
additional_properties: Structural schemas are reused technical contracts. Opaque parameter fields remain outside binding discovery.
